annotations.title: Check a handled attack surface item again

description: Run the targeted re-check behind "It's handled" again, for a handled item the last check still saw or could not finish. No credits; the same hourly limit as marking an item handled applies, and a check already running is not started twice. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator, who must be a member or above.

decisionId.description: The decision's id, from list_attack_surface_needs or list_attack_surface_decisions.

name: recheck_attack_surface_decision
